subject: How to run ShinyApp and pull data over a network?

messages.author: 21ed51ab50604256
messages.subject: How to run ShinyApp and pull data over a network?
parts:
So I've uploaded my ShinyApp project to the glimmer beta site so that I could share it with other non-R users, but my project pulls data and sources other scripts over my company's internal network.  When I try to run my application from a networked computer it has trouble with this.
 
 
Is there a way to handle this other than by storing my data/files on a public Dropbox account?
